lines.trans: Rest assured, I forgot about past matters long ago; let us compete fairly shortly.
The pitch meeting is starting; everyone come inside.
The biggest highlight of my proposal is pre-selecting several aid centres in need of funding.
Then we arrange for them each to present before Xin Huimei and her fans.
Finally, Xin Huimei selects one recipient organisation to fund.
Doing this reflects the values of Xin Huimei's charity fund while showing everyone its practicality.
That concludes my programme proposal.
Both sides have finished presenting; step outside and wait for word first.
Unit Two's proposal shows clear progress, though Bu Xiaogu's plan is more original.
Since Entertainment Talk is preparing a revamp, let us start with Huimei's charity special.
The proposal passed? Really? I will go notify Brother Fenhong right now to prepare for taping!
